name: ModeBar
description: The strip. Put `ModeBarContent` in it, then the `ModeBarAction` that ends the mode.

name: ModeBarAction
description: The text action that ends the mode (Done), at the end of the first line. A real `button`; on the HUD it is a text action, like a toast's, never a Button.

name: ModeBarContent
description: The words: `ModeBarTitle`, then `ModeBarDescription`, on one line that wraps. A polite live region, so a change to the title (a draft count) is read out; the action stays outside it.

name: ModeBarDescription
description: What to do in the mode, in the muted HUD ink, after the title on the same line. It brings the space before it, so the two read and copy as one sentence.

name: ModeBarTitle
description: The mode and its state, bold in the HUD ink: "Commenting · 1 draft."
